name: Aiko — decent, middling pilot across the board, nothing alarming but nothing excellent either
summary: A pilot who answers consistently in the middle band on almost every skills question — meets the 100+/year currency bar but is otherwise unremarkable — with a strong psychological profile.
why_this_persona: Tests the raised Ready threshold (85, up from 79 one rung down) in a realistic middling profile. This pilot's total lands in the nearly_ready band purely because the overall total doesn't reach 85, illustrating how the stricter threshold at this step changes outcomes for a pilot who might have cleared the bar one rung down with the same underlying skill level.

notes: Computed against the real engine: total 82.1, skills 66.2, psych 100.0. rules_expected is empty by design: the engine only reports a Ready-path threshold rule (critical_check_floor / ready_category_floor) when the total itself reaches the Ready threshold of 85 — this persona's total (82.1) falls short of 85 on its own, so the nearly_ready result comes from the total-threshold check, not a category-floor violation. This is a genuinely different path from low-c-to-high-c's equivalent persona 08, which did trip a floor rule, and is worth the reviewer checking is correct engine behaviour rather than a missing rule.

airtime_last_12m answers 100_150, clearing the new currency bar comfortably, which is why 'build_annual_currency' correctly stays silent despite the otherwise middling skills profile — this persona is specifically NOT a currency case.
